raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: librsvg
  version: "2.62.3"
  abi_version: "2.0"
  version_majmin: ${{ (version | split('.'))[:2] | join('.') }}
  name_abi: ${{ name + "-" + abi_version }}
  vs_major: "17"  # check VS_MAJOR in the build output
  lib: ${{ name + "-" + (abi_version | split('.'))[0] if unix else "rsvg-" + abi_version }}

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://download.gnome.org/sources/${{ name }}/${{ version_majmin }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.xz
  sha256: 7eb449b2722a768021356f66dfee3202c229b54ed4e6a70ce40c090e97ff16f2
  patches:
    - add_rust_lto.patch
    - if: win
      then: windows_gir.patch

build:
  number: 1

requirements:
  build:
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
    - cargo-c
    - docutils
    - gi-docgen
    - gobject-introspection
    - if: win
      then: meson <1.12  # 1.12 mishandles c_link_args it seems
      else: meson
    - ninja
    - pkg-config
    # Rust 1.95 on Windows is putting executables into target/x86_64-pc-windows-msvc/release/
    # instead of target/release, which Meson isn't expecting.
    - if: win
      then: ${{ compiler('rust') }} <1.95
      else: ${{ compiler('rust') }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - cairo
        - fontconfig
        - freetype
        - gdk-pixbuf
        - glib
        - harfbuzz
        - if: linux
          then: libpng
        - libxml2-devel
        - pango
        # needed for devel files (e.g. pkg-config):
        - expat
        - liblzma-devel
        - xorg-xorgproto
        - zlib
  host:
    - glib
    - libxml2-devel
    - cairo
    - gdk-pixbuf
    - pango
    - harfbuzz
    - if: linux
      then: libpng
    - freetype
    - fontconfig
    - expat
    - liblzma-devel
    - xorg-xorgproto
    - zlib
  run_exports:
    - ${{ pin_subpackage('librsvg', upper_bound='x') }}
  ignore_run_exports:
    by_name:
      - libxml2
    from_package:
      - expat
      - if: win
        then: fontconfig
      - freetype
      - liblzma-devel
      - libpng
      - zlib

tests:
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pkg-config
    script:
      - rsvg-convert --version
      - if: unix
        then:
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/${{ lib }}${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test ! -f $PREFIX/lib/${{ lib }}.a
          - test -f `pkg-config --variable=libdir --dont-define-prefix ${{ name_abi }}`/${{ lib }}${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/gdk-pixbuf-2.0/2.10.0/loaders/libpixbufloader_svg${SHLIB_EXT}
          - test ! -f $PREFIX/lib/gdk-pixbuf-2.0/2.10.0/loaders/libpixbufloader_svg.a
          - test -f $PREFIX/include/${{ name_abi }}/${{ name }}/rsvg-features.h
          - test -f $PREFIX/include/${{ name_abi }}/${{ name }}/rsvg-cairo.h
          - test -f $PREFIX/include/${{ name_abi }}/${{ name }}/rsvg.h
          - test -f $PREFIX/lib/girepository-1.0/Rsvg-2.0.typelib
      - if: win
        then:
          - if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\bin\\${{ lib }}-vs${{ vs_major }}.dll exit 1
          - for /f "usebackq tokens=*" %%a in (`pkg-config --variable=exec_prefix --dont-define-prefix ${{ name_abi }}`) do if not exist "%%a/bin/${{ lib }}-vs${{ vs_major }}.dll" exit 1
          - if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\lib\\${{ lib }}.lib exit 1
          - for /f "usebackq tokens=*" %%a in (`pkg-config --variable=libdir --dont-define-prefix ${{ name_abi }}`) do if not exist "%%a/${{ lib }}.lib" exit 1
          - if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\lib\\gdk-pixbuf-2.0\\2.10.0\\loaders\\libpixbufloader_svg.dll exit 1
          - if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\include\\${{ name_abi }}\\${{ name }}\\rsvg-features.h exit 1
          - if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\include\\${{ name_abi }}\\${{ name }}\\rsvg-cairo.h exit 1
          - if not exist %PREFIX%\\Library\\include\\${{ name_abi }}\\${{ name }}\\rsvg.h exit 1
          - if not exist %LIBRARY_LIB%\\girepository-1.0\\Rsvg-2.0.typelib exit 1

about:
  license: LGPL-2.1-or-later
  license_file:
    - COPYING.LIB
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
  summary: librsvg is a library to render SVG files using cairo.
  homepage: https://wiki.gnome.org/Projects/LibRsvg

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - pkgw
    - tschoonj
    - xhochy
